newsitem.title: USA: Standard Products Q3 net falls after charge.
newsitem.headline: Standard Products Q3 net falls after charge.

text.p: Standard Products Co said Tuesday its earnings in the third quarter ended March 31 included a charge to cover the previously announced closing of two automotive parts plants in New York and Kentucky.
The company reported net income of $515,000, or $0.03 a share, down from $7.3 million, or $0.43, a year ago. Sales climbed to $281.8 million from $277.3 million last year.
The pre-tax charge related to the plant closings totaled $17.7 million, or $0.63 a share, Standard Products said.
The company said the closings are proceeding on schedule.
Standard Products makes sealing, trimming and vibration control systems for the automotive and other industries.
